pattern_families.label: Standard family register with separate BOY and GIRL columns
pattern_families.description: Genealogy tables with headers: NAME, BORN, MARRIED, SPOUSE, BOY, GIRL, DIED. Each chapter contains a single table, no subgroup/context rows, no summary tables, and marginal/aside notes for additional children attached by data-person.

document_local_conventions.subgroup_context_rows: Not used; all rows are standard person entries.
document_local_conventions.table_fragmentation: Not present; one table per chapter.
document_local_conventions.marginal_or_handwritten_notes: Handled as asides with data-person attribute, not as table rows or cells.
